stance_basis: paraphrased as wanting to explore without undue restrictions, grouped among mining interests seeking exemption from ORV regulations
summary: Mine Finders, Inc. commented on the draft ORV environmental statement, expressing a desire to conduct mineral exploration on public lands without undue restrictions from ORV regulations. Their concern was grouped with numerous other mining and geophysical exploration interests who objected to permit requirements for mining vehicles. The Department responded by excepting mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the definition of off-road vehicles in the final environmental statement.
complaint_summary: Mine Finders, Inc. wanted to be able to conduct mineral exploration without undue restrictions from ORV regulations.
summary_quote: I urge you, therefore, to work out some licensing arrangement that would permit the exploration geologist to conduct his studies without undue restriction.
